title: Air Quality Dashboard
footer_text: Data from 2 AQ dust sensors | Updated every 3 seconds
desc_temperature_very_hot: Very hot conditions - potential health concern
desc_relative_humidity_very_low: Very low humidity - respiratory discomfort likely
desc_relative_humidity_low: Low humidity - may cause dry skin and respiratory irritation
desc_relative_humidity_normal: Acceptable humidity - WHO minimum comfort standard
desc_relative_humidity_very_high: Very high humidity - dust mite risk
desc_pressure_very_low: Very low pressure - stormy weather likely
desc_pressure_low: Low pressure - unsettled weather, possible rain
desc_pressure_very_high: Very high pressure - very dry conditions
desc_visible_light_adequate: Adequate lighting - suitable for general activities
desc_visible_light_bright: Bright lighting - good for detailed tasks
desc_voc_index_good: The air is typical or better than usual for indoor environments, with minimal or no pollution events
desc_voc_index_moderate: Minor pollution event detected; likely due to brief activities such as cooking, cleaning, or transient odors
desc_voc_index_poor: Emissions from products, heavier cleaning, or increased occupancy
desc_voc_index_very_poor: Persistent emissions or strong pollutant sources present
desc_voc_index_hazardous: Prolonged exposure may cause discomfort or health effects
desc_nox_index_good: Near background NOx levels, generally safe for indoor environments
desc_nox_index_moderate: Slight increase, often related to brief combustion events (e.g., stove use, traffic infiltration)
desc_nox_index_poor: Clear NOx event, likely from prolonged combustion (gas cooking, traffic, nearby industries)
desc_nox_index_very_poor: High NOx; frequent and/or intense combustion sources nearby
desc_nox_index_hazardous: Critically high NOx, levels associated with acute health risks for sensitive groups
desc_radon_1day_avg_good: Radon levels are within safe limits.
desc_radon_1day_avg_fair: Elevated radon levels detected; consider mitigation.
desc_radon_1day_avg_poor: Very high radon levels; immediate action required.
desc_radon_week_avg_good: Radon levels are within safe limits.
desc_radon_week_avg_fair: Elevated radon levels detected; consider mitigation.
desc_radon_week_avg_poor: Very high radon levels; immediate action required.
desc_radon_year_avg_good: Radon levels are within safe limits.
desc_radon_year_avg_fair: Elevated radon levels detected; consider mitigation.
desc_radon_year_avg_poor: Very high radon levels; immediate action required.
desc_o3_good: Clean air with minimal ozone; typical for well‑ventilated indoor spaces or low‑pollution outdoor conditions.
desc_o3_moderate: Acceptable air quality; sensitive individuals may begin to notice mild irritation during prolonged outdoor exposure.
desc_o3_poor: Above WHO guideline levels; may cause throat irritation, coughing, or reduced lung function during outdoor activity.
desc_o3_very_poor: Unhealthy for most people; prolonged exposure can aggravate respiratory conditions and reduce exercise capacity.
desc_o3_hazardous: High ozone concentration; can trigger asthma symptoms and significant respiratory stress—avoid outdoor exertion.
desc_no2_good: Very low NO₂ levels; typical of clean outdoor air or well‑ventilated indoor environments.
desc_no2_moderate: Acceptable air quality; may indicate nearby traffic or combustion sources but generally safe.
desc_no2_poor: Above WHO guideline levels; prolonged exposure may irritate airways, especially for sensitive individuals.
desc_no2_very_poor: Unhealthy concentration; can aggravate asthma and reduce lung function with repeated exposure.
desc_no2_hazardous: High NO₂ levels; associated with significant respiratory inflammation—avoid exposure and improve ventilation immediately.
desc_co_good: Background CO typical of clean indoor or outdoor air; no expected health effects for the general population.
desc_co_moderate: Slightly elevated CO often from traffic, cooking, or heaters; generally safe for short exposure but should not be persistent.
desc_co_unhealthy_sensitive: Level where repeated or multi‑hour exposure may affect sensitive groups such as people with heart or respiratory conditions.
desc_co_unhealthy: Prolonged exposure can cause headache, fatigue, and reduced exercise tolerance; ventilation or source mitigation needed.
desc_co_very_unhealthy: Short‑term exposure may cause significant symptoms like dizziness and nausea; indicates a potentially dangerous situation.
desc_co_hazardous: High CO where exposure of tens of minutes can be life‑threatening; immediate evacuation and source shutdown required.
desc_co_extreme_hazard: Even short exposure can be rapidly fatal and demands urgent emergency response.
settings_device_hint: Applies to all screens and to the notifications.
settings_save_error: The settings could not be saved: {error}
provisional_note: * Provisional: data available for {coverage}% of the averaging period.
comfort_out_of_range: * Outside the validity range of the model
settings_risk_formula: Index = {factor} × Σ (exp(β · C) − 1), rounded to an integer (minimum 1); above 10 shown as 10+.
settings_pm25_correction_note: Plantower sensors overestimate PM2.5, especially at high humidity. The correction uses the average of the two sensors and the relative humidity, and applies to the indices; the tiles show the raw readings.
settings_dust_health: Health of the two dust sensors
dust_learning_note: The drift detection needs 8 days with enough particles (5 days of baseline after the installation and 3 recent days); the other checks are active immediately.
dust_reset: The dust sensors have been replaced
dust_reset_confirm: Start a new baseline for the drift detection? Only do this after replacing the dust sensors.
dust_reset_note: After replacing the sensors, a new baseline is learned from the next complete days.
settings_show_dust_tiles: Show the measurements of the dust sensors
maintenance_dust_sensors_disagree: The two dust sensors disagree in {flagged_hours} of the last {valid_hours} hours (difference over 5 µg/m³ and 70 %).
maintenance_dust_sensors_disagree_action: One of the sensors is faulty: replace the dust sensors.
maintenance_dust_sensors_drift: The readings of the two dust sensors have drifted apart by {drift_pct} % since {since}.
maintenance_dust_sensors_drift_action: The sensors no longer measure correctly: replace the dust sensors.
maintenance_dust_sensors_uncorrelated: The readings of the two dust sensors have been poorly correlated on the last 3 days (r = {correlation}).
maintenance_dust_sensors_uncorrelated_ac: A sensor, its fan or its laser is failing: replace the dust sensors.
maintenance_dust_sensor_stuck: Dust sensor {sensor} has reported the same value ({value} µg/m³) for 3 hours while the other one varies.
maintenance_dust_sensor_missing: Dust sensor {sensor} sends no data while the other one does.
maintenance_dust_sensor_missing_action: Check the connection of dust sensor {sensor} or replace it.
sensor_flag_warning: {sensor}: possible problem found by the sensor checks (see the settings)
sensor_flag_alarm: {sensor}: problem found by the sensor checks (see the settings)
validation_out_of_range: {sensor} {quantity}: {count} readings of the last 24 h are outside the valid range ({low} to {high} {unit}).
validation_out_of_range_action: Check the sensor and its connection; replace it if the readings stay implausible.
validation_jumps: {sensor} {quantity}: {count} implausible jumps in the last 24 h.
validation_jumps_action: Check the connection of the sensor and that it is not exposed to a draught, the sun or a heat source.
validation_stuck_action: The sensor seems frozen: restart its service; replace it if the problem persists.
validation_gaps: {sensor}: data for only {percent} % of the last 24 h.
validation_gaps_action: Check the connection and the service of the sensor.
validation_drift: The {quantity} of {sensor} has drifted by {drift} {unit} compared with the other sensors.
validation_drift_action: Recalibrate or replace {sensor}, then start a new baseline in the settings.
validation_drift_pair: The {quantity} of {sensor} and {other} have drifted apart by {drift} {unit}.
validation_drift_pair_action: One of the two sensors drifts: compare them with a reference and recalibrate or replace the wrong one.
validation_co2_baseline_low: {sensor}: the lowest CO₂ level of the last 7 days ({value} ppm) is below the outdoor level, which is impossible indoors.
validation_co2_baseline_low_action: Recalibrate the CO₂ sensor (forced recalibration in fresh outdoor air) or replace it.
validation_co2_baseline_high: {sensor}: the CO₂ level has not come down to the outdoor level for 7 days (lowest {value} ppm).
validation_co2_baseline_high_action: Air the room thoroughly at least once a week (the sensor calibrates itself with fresh air); if the level stays high, recalibrate the sensor.
settings_health_hint: Checks of the measurements with their history: valid range, jumps, stuck values, gaps, drift between the sensors, CO₂ baseline.
health_reset: A sensor has been replaced or recalibrated
health_reset_confirm: Start a new baseline for the drift checks of the sensors? Only do this after replacing or recalibrating a sensor.
health_reset_note: The drift checks then learn a new baseline from the next complete days.
auth_error_locked: Too many failed attempts: try again in {seconds} s.
auth_error_password_too_short: The password must have at least {min} characters.
auth_error_invalid_username: The user name may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-' (at most 32).
auth_error_already_set_up: The administrator account already exists: please log in.
settings_defaults_hint: Restores the recommended profiles and options (US EPA AQI, EN 16798-1 CO₂ categories, WHO indoor noise, ISO 7730 PMV with seasonal clothing, Barkjohn PM2.5 correction) and the display options of this browser.
settings_restore_confirm: Restore the recommended profiles and the default display options?
remember_me: Keep me logged in on this device
setup_hint: Enter the setup code written in the log of the server when it started (e.g. journalctl -u aq_dashboard).
strength_requirement: At least {min} characters. A few unrelated words make a strong password that is easy to remember.
strength_hint_user_name: Do not use your user name.
strength_hint_common: Avoid common passwords and words (also with @ for a, 0 for o…).
strength_hint_passphrase: Tip: a longer password of a few unrelated words is stronger.
auth_error_password_too_weak: The password is too weak: follow the hints below the field.
auth_error_password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.
auth_error_auth_disabled: The login is disabled on this device.
change_hint: You logged in with a default or temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
password_changed_login: Your password has been changed. Log in with the new password.
password_change_logout_note: After the change, you are logged out on all devices: log in again with the new password.
